Wow thanks you guys for future donations of holograms for the exhibit, I will mount them all and include a your bio. (Taken from your web sites). I will send you the write-up or whatever coverage we get. My emphasis will be on hobby holography, and the new advantages we now have, Internet feedback (holography forum), affordability of lasers

and optics ect.

About two years ago I approached our local adult-education director about renting a small room to set up a educational/working holography lab,(large school now used only for childcare and adult ed.), by the time I left our meeting he had talked me into doing a class on holography, they ran the write-up for the class in the catalog……….. Only two or three People Signed up, so naturally they cut it out ,as time passed more people made inquiries (totaling 8 more possibilities) , the library is always welcome to any science/educational based theme ,any way ,I could run the class again but first showing a display of hobby holography at the local library …….. The local newspaper will also do coverage as I do work at the editor’s house all the time! 

I have a bunch of Polaroid holograms (some rare) I will trade/swap for any of your holos…….
